finding.scenario: P2P HOST was preserved on route 1 while authority refreshes advanced the attempt to route 3; the old native HOST then really DISCONNECTED. Backend keeps the attempt route at 3 and increments the HOST authorization/connection generation from 1 to 2.
finding.toolbox_behavior: runtime::refresh_p2p_authority selects the fresh-HOST branch after active_match_host_connection is cleared, but host_connection_ownership_for_refresh requires pending_cleanup.route_generation + 1 == material.route_generation. After the preceding route-3 preservation, pending cleanup is route 3, so the same-route generation-2 recovery is rejected before the current allocation is installed or host_ready is sent.
finding.not_authority_ready_only: The normal fresh branch would fetch and verify the current route-3 allocation, install it, start a new native authority nonce, call host_ready, then wait for the Backend HOST CONNECTED proof (including the incremented generation). It is currently unreachable for this same-route post-disconnect shape.
finding.minimum_fix_boundary: Allow a released exact old HOST proof when pending cleanup route equals current material route and the released scope route is older, in addition to the existing exact-next-route case. Keep active ownership rejection, exact attempt/session/world/roster/player/role checks, accepted Backend DISCONNECTED prerequisite, and fresh native nonce/Backend proof. Do not use the preserved-host path or old nonce after DISCONNECTED; add a same-route generation regression.

evidence.detail: host_connection_ownership_for_refresh rejects unless pending route + 1 equals material route
refresh chooses fresh branch after active host ownership is absent and calls the strict released-proof gate
fresh branch waits for current Backend HOST proof and would retain the returned connection_generation
real HOST disconnect after a prior route refresh clears the old live scope and increments connection_generation while retaining route
normal P2PAuthorityReady after DISCONNECTED installs a fresh nonce at the current route and current connection_generation
